scope: Only two official product pages (PLA+ and PETG) have been transcribed so far; manufacturer offers further PLA and PETG lines that remain to be imported.
notes: HEX values were taken from the manufacturer's page swatches, not measured physical print colors.
eSUN region/language storefront variants can show a different WHITE HEX; this import consistently uses the canonical English URL without locale parameters.
Translucent eSUN PETG shades use an uncalibrated transparent-surface override to approximate their appearance.
